statement: A change that touches only release workflows and scripts can still change what users download, so it needs a changelog entry when it merges. #404 rebuilt the per-binary and image SBOMs and attested them, but it changed no src file and merged with no [Unreleased] entry. The 0.6.1 card's summary named #411 to #415 as the changes since v0.6.0. The tag sits on #403's merge, so `git log v0.6.0..origin/main` (which the card's step 1 also asked for) held #404, #405 and #408 as well; working from the summary alone, #404 would have shipped unrecorded. Rule: scope a release changelog from `git log <previous tag>..origin/main`, never from a card's list of PRs, and treat any change to a published artifact (SBOM, attestation, image tags, asset set) as user-visible even when no product code moved.
